jobs.description:
As a Customer Support Assistant, you will be responsible for delivering a smooth and professional customer experience from the first contact through to order delivery.
 
 

• Be the first point of contact for distributors and end users, handling questions, requests and issues in a professional and customer-oriented way. 

• Manage the complete order process, from order intake through logistics, including coordinating shipments and transport. 

• Provide high-quality customer support via phone, email and chat. 

• Follow up on customer requests and issues and ensure timely and effective resolution. 

• Keep customer information, interactions and issues accurately recorded in our CRM system. 

• Identify recurring customer issues and share insights with internal teams to help improve our products and services. 

• Proactively identify opportunities to improve our customer service processes and contribute to initiatives that make our way of working more efficient. 

• Work closely with colleagues across different teams to ensure a seamless customer experience. 

You are a customer-oriented and solution-focused person who enjoys taking ownership and working in a fast-paced environment.
 

You bring:
 
 

• Fluency in English and French, both written and spoken - this is essential. 

• A minimum of a Bachelor's degree is required. 

• Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. 

• A structured and accurate way of working, with a strong eye for detail. 

• The ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks while maintaining a high level of service. 

• A proactive, positive and customer-centric mindset. 

• Previous experience in customer support, order administration or a similar role is a plus. 

• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is an advantage.

- Maximum responsible for sourcing and procurement within the BU.
 

- Implements all the purchase procedures, aligning them with business processes according to the Group Purchase Policy.

- Helps identifying opportunities for cost savings related with the purchasing function (standardization and rationalization, aggregate purchases, processes optimization, etc.)

- Implements procurement best practices for all commodities and services, optimizing the processes by using SAP MM.

- Reports periodically to the Central Purchase Department

- Is eligible for carrying on the function of Lead buyer reporting to Central Purchasing.
 

- Is eligible for carrying on some international projects.

-
 Educated to degree level, with an appropriate professional qualification. 
 

-
 purchase experience in a multi-national, environment. 
 

-
 Experience with high-value, high-volume purchasing across a range of services and commodities
 

-
 Experience with developing and implementing successful cost saving initiatives
 

-
 Experience with SAP or other ERP is a plus
 

-
 Computer literate, with a good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Power Point and word processing or similar applications
 

-
 Good oral and written Flemish, French and English are essential

As a Solutions Engineer, you are responsible for both the design and implementation of logistics solutions for new and existing customers.

 
• Analyze customer requirements, operational data and logistics flows
 
• Design efficient warehouse processes, layouts and automation concepts
 
• Develop pricing models, cost calculations and business cases
 
• Prepare and present tailored logistics solutions and proposals
 
• Manage implementation projects from concept to go-live
 
• Coordinate cross-functional teams including Operations, Engineering, IT, Customer Service and external stakeholders
 
• Monitor project scope, budget, planning and operational readiness
 
• Ensure a successful start-up and smooth transition into daily operations
 
• Identify process improvements and contribute to continuous optimization initiatives
 
• Support business development activities and participate in customer meetings and negotiations.

Your profile:

 
• Minimum 5 years of experience within logistics, warehousing or supply chain operations
 
• Strong analytical skills with experience in cost calculations, productivity analyses, process design and ROI assessments
 
• Experience managing projects and coordinating multiple stakeholders
 
• Customer-oriented mindset with excellent communication skills
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities and a hands-on approach
 
• Able to work effectively under tight deadlines
 
• Team player with leadership capabilities
 
• Excellent command of English
 
• Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is considered an asset
 
• Willingness to travel internationally when required, including longer project assignments abroad (+-3 months).

The Lead Buyer will be in charge of the following missions:
 
 

• Responsible for sourcing and procurement within the BU. 

• Implements all the purchase procedures, aligning them with business processes according to the Group Purchase Policy. 

• Helps identifying opportunities for cost savings related with the purchasing function (standardization and rationalization, aggregate purchases, processes optimization, etc.) 

• Implements procurement best practices for all commodities and services, optimizing the processes by using SAP MM. 

• Implements the supplier evaluation and contract awarding (through Negotiation Tables) processes. 

• Reports periodically to the Central Purchase Department 

• Is eligible for carrying on some international projects. 
 

•  

Educated to degree level, with an appropriate professional qualification. 
  

• Purchase experience  

• Experience with developing and implementing successful cost saving initiatives. 

• Computer literate 

• Good oral and written Flemish, French and English

Scope
 

The main role of the CAD (Cadence) support engineer is to provide CAD support for all design and layout engineers and to ensure continuous improvement of the ICsense design environment for higher efficiency and user friendliness. You work closely together with other CAD Support Engineers. 
 

Responsibilities
 

· Develop custom tools (from automation scripts to GUI’s) for the ICsense design environment in Python, SKILL and Matlab
 

· Act as CAD Support Engineer: 
 

 maintenance and configuration of the CAD tools (Cadence, Synopsys, Siemens, Matlab, Perforce, ...)
 

 maintenance, development and configuration of the proprietary ICsense design environment
 

 maintenance and installation of the IC technologies and PDKs at ICsense
 

 give CAD support for the designers and layouters at ICsense
 

· Work closely together with other CAD Support Engineers
 

· CAD user group: participate in the regular meetings and ensure follow up of the discussed items
 

· Support internal CAD training initiatives
 

· Write documentation, manuals and keep the CAD information on Confluence up to date

Competences
 
 

• You have a Bachelor or Master degree in Electronics or Informatics 

• You have experience with programming languages like Python, scripting 

• You have experience working in a Linux environment  

• You have an affinity for ASIC design/layout or PCB concepts  

• Experience with CAD tools from Cadence/Synopsys/Siemens/Matlab is a plus 

• You communicate fluently in English (oral and written) 

• You are well-organized and able to work independently while solving problems effectively

You coordinate and supervise the food, team & workload from our central prep kitchen, which supplies to outlets in multiple sites around Brussel
 
 

• Work and manage bulk production, cooking, packing & finishing. 

• Handle orders from each outlet. 

• Place orders with multiple suppliers. 

• Manage stocks and inventory. 

• Plan daily, weekly & monthly workload. 

• Co-ordinate workload between day kitchen and evening shift. 

• Maintain a clean workspace and take care of kitchen tools. 

• Respect safety standards during the work. 

• Label and store all food according to HACCP standards. 

• Receive and check goods received. 

• Collaborate with the rest of the (culinary) team to ensure high-quality food and service for North Indian, South Indian and sweets 
 

• Min 5 year experience as a chef 

• Experience in Managing multiple outlets with Experience in similar positions. 

• Knowledge of Indian Cuisine is a must. 

• Good level of English/Hindi both spoken & written 

• Able to follow and execute under instruction & good in communication. 

• Team player & trouble-shooter 

• Knowledge of HACCP 

• Able to multitask and work efficiently under pressure.

Are you an expert in elevator technology with a passion for troubleshooting? Do you enjoy working independently and managing your own service route? We are looking for an experienced Service Technician (Elevators) to join our professional team in the East and West Flanders regions.

 

As a Senior Service Technician, you are the technical face of the company. You will be responsible for the safety, reliability, and optimal performance of a diverse portfolio of lift installations.

 

Your Key Responsibilities:

• Maintenance & Inspection: Perform periodic preventive maintenance according to safety standards and regulations.
• Diagnostics & Fault-finding: Identify and resolve complex mechanical and electrical malfunctions independently.
• Repairs: Execute necessary repairs and replace worn or damaged components.
• Technical Reporting: Document your work clearly and advise clients on necessary upgrades or preventive measures.
• Safety: Ensure all work is carried out according to the strictest safety protocols.
 

• Experience: At least 5 years of experience in elevator maintenance and troubleshooting is mandatory.
• Education: A technical degree in Electromechanics, Electricity, or Maintenance Technology (or equivalent through experience).
• Independence: Ability to work autonomously "on the road" with a strong sense of responsibility.
• Languages: Fluent in English and/or Dutch.
• Certifications: * Valid Driver’s License B (mandatory).
• VCA certification is a major plus.
• BA5 (Competent person for electrical installations) is highly preferred.
• Soft Skills: Customer-oriented, problem-solver, and flexible mindset.

What will your working day look like? 

As a Production Worker - assembly | 2 Shifts, you will have a varied range of tasks:

•    You will assemble various parts using automated CNC machines.

•    You will ensure your workstation is stocked with the necessary materials and components.

•    You will carry out quality checks on finished products.

•    You will be responsible for light finishing tasks such as screwing, assembling and packaging.

•    You will ensure a tidy and safe workplace.

•    You will work standing up and be actively engaged throughout the entire working day.

As a Production Worker - Assembly | 2 Shifts, you combine accuracy with a good work pace.

 
What superpowers do you need?

-    You have technical insight or a strong practical mindset

-    You work with precision and a focus on quality

-    You don’t shy away from physical work

-    You are willing to work a two-shift system

-    You communicate fluently in Dutch or English

Are you interested in a job as Powder Coater? And are you ready for a quick start? Then read further!
For a company located in Wingene, we are looking for a Powder Coater!

What are your tasks?

• Prepare and cleane the metal parts
• Hang or position items that need to be coated
• Apply the powder coating by spraying
• Perform quality checks 
• Operate the curing oven
Hours: day hours Monday to Friday, often working on Saturdays

Who are you?

• You have experience in production, preferably as powder coater or within a company of sorts
• You speak English or Polish 
• You have your own transportation
• You are available quickly

jobs.description:
Job description
 

· As the Group HSE Governance & Policy Lead you will be working closely with local HSE teams and business leaders, you will develop policies, strengthen governance, promote best practices and help create a strong safety culture throughout the organisation. 
 

· You will develop, maintain and continuously improve the Group HSE Management System; define, implement and harmonise HSE policies, standards and procedures across all business entities. 
 

· As the Group HSE Governance & Policy Lead you ensure alignment with local legislation while maintaining a common Group HSE framework, you’ll coordinate the implementation of governance processes in different regions across Europe. 
 

· You will lead corporate HSE initiatives and continuous improvement programmes, and drive the development of a proactive safety culture across the organisation. 
 

· As the Group HSE Governance & Policy Lead you will monitor changes in European and local HSE legislation and translate these into Group policies, and support senior leadership by providing strategic HSE advice and reporting.

Your profile 
 

· 
 You obtained a Master Degree in a related discipline, or equivalent by experience. 
 

· 
 You have relevant expertise with HSE Governance & Policy within an industrial, infrastructure, engineering or renewable energy environment.
 

· 
 Proven experience in developing HSE management systems, governance frameworks and corporate policies. 
 

· 
 Analytical, structured and able to translate strategy into practical policies. 
 

· 
 Strong knowledge of English, and Dutch and/or French.

Job description
 

● 
 As a Project Delivery Lead you initiate and coordinate all project phases: from the concept and development phase to the commissioning. 
 

● 
 You are responsible for monitoring and managing the project costs, and for the planning of the project resources. 
 

● 
 As a Project Delivery Lead you negotiate with the site owners and network operators and maintain close contacts with local administrations, policy makers and all stakeholders involved. 
 

● 
 As a Project Delivery Lead you prepare investment decisions and assist in the negotiations with the parties involved. 
 

● 
 You streamline communication with other parties such as architects, engineers, site managers and the finance department. 
 

● 
 As a Project Delivery Lead you closely follow the project planning, make adjustments where necessary, and report on the project progress and the milestones. 

Your profile 
 

● 
 You have a Master degree in Engineering (Industrial, Civil, …) or equivalent level of education. 
 

● 
 You have relevant experience in project management, preferably 
in Hydrogen, Renewable Energy or similar industries. 
 

● 
 You are passionate about Hydrogen, Renewable Energy and/or environmental technologies. 
 

● 
 You have strong coordinating skills and are able of successfully managing all parties involved. 
 

● 
 Excellent knowledge of English, and able to communicate in Dutch and/or French. 
 

● 
 You are communicative, have strong people skills and can take initiative.

Job description
 

● As a Business Developer – Renewable Energy you‘ll be identifying, initiating and developing large & innovative Solar, Wind, EV charging infrastructure, Energy Management System (EMS) and BESS projects.
 

● You’ll be creating a business development plan for the Renewable Energy strategy and be enlarging your contact list with potential clients using leads, your personal network and prospection.
 

● As a Business Developer – Renewable Energy you’ll be educating clients on the features and technical specifications; you’ll be formulating a business plan that benefit both the clients and the organization. You’re always aiming for win-win outcomes.
 

● You’ll be securing renewable installation and infrastructure projects: contracts for installing innovative hybrid Wind turbines, large Solar installations on rooftops or ground-mounted systems, EV charging projects, BESS, Energy Management System (EMS) projects, etc.
 

● As a Business Developer – Renewable Energy you act as the primary contact for local and regional stakeholders; you’ll identify growth possibilities and propose ideas for hybrid Solar, Wind, EV charging installations, Energy Management System (EMS) and BESS opportunities.
 

● You’ll be building partnerships with multiple stakeholders to increase visibility and lead generation, you’ll participating in internal meetings with the business development and project management teams.

Your profile 
 

●You have a Master or Bachelor degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, etc. or an equivalent level of education. 
 

●You have commercial aptitude and relevant experience in B2B prospecting, contract negotiation and similar domains. 
 

●You are passionate about Renewable Energy and/or environmental technologies. 
 

●Good knowledge of English and are able to communicate in Dutch and/ or French. 
 

●You are communicative, have strong people skills and solution selling skills.

For a client in Duffel we are looking for a temporary 
Customer Service Representative.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• You process customer orders accurately, efficiently, and in a timely manner, while closely following up to ensure excellent customer service. 

• You respond to customer inquiries and emails and ensure smooth communication with clients. 

• You manage metal contracts and related administration. 

• You handle customer complaints in a professional and solution-oriented way. 

• You support the sales team with efficient administrative organization to guarantee continuity and high-quality customer support.  

 

Profile
 
 

• You hold at least a bachelor’s degree, preferably in a commercial or administrative field. 

• You have an excellent command of English and German. Additional languages are considered a plus. 

• You are comfortable working with Microsoft Office applications; knowledge of SAP is an advantage. 

• Experience in or affinity with an industrial environment is a strong asset. 

• You are stress-resistant and able to work efficiently under pressure. 

• You are customer-oriented, communicative, and a good listener. 

• You are proactive, persistent, and able to think creatively when solving problems.

What you will do
 

As a Supply Chain Solution Manager for Full Turn Key ASIC (application specific integrated circuit) production within imec.IC-link, you will serve as the critical interface between international customers and our ecosystem of semiconductor foundries, assembly houses, and test facilities. You take up responsibility for the full production, planning and on-time-delivery. This is a new position, to support the growing complexity of our Full Turn Key ASIC programs.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Overall planning related to wafer production, assembly, and test activities. 

• Defining the supply chain flow and managing the official handover of projects from the engineering team to the production team. 

• Monitoring production milestones and ensuring on-time delivery. 

• Aligning with the Production team lead on project status and priorities. 

• Monthly alignment with sales, account managers, and team lead on customer forecasts and subcontractor capacities. 

• Daily follow-up and update of production deliveries using IMEC’s WIP (Work-in-Progress) database system. 

• Reviewing incoming purchase orders from customers and generating corresponding purchase orders for subcontractors. 

• Coordinating global shipments to subcontractors and end customers. 

• Managing complex projects involving dynamic customer rolling forecasts and evolving subcontractor capacities. 

Who you are
 
 

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, or a related field. 

• You bring 5 to 8 years of experience in supply chain operations, preferably in the semiconductor, electronics, or high-tech manufacturing industry. 

• You are highly organized, accurate, and proactive, with strong skills in production planning, supplier coordination, and customer communication. 

• You are proficient in Microsoft Excel and Power BI for data analysis and reporting. 

• Diplomatic and with strong communication skills, you engage stakeholders in meeting deadlines, adhering to quality standards and achieving goals within budget. 

• You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and enjoy working closely with engineering, operations, and customer-facing teams. 

• You are fluent in English (written and spoken). Knowledge of other languages is a plus.

Bier Central Brussels is the place where beer lovers can indulge their passion.

With 
over 300 beers on the menu, warm hospitality, and a kitchen that satisfies every appetite, we’re a staple in the heart of Brussels—just a stone’s throw from 
Brussels Central Station.
 

 
 

Our passionate team is looking for a 
new colleague (Flexi) who shares our enthusiasm and energy to join our bustling establishment.
 

 
 

As a server/bartender, you are the face of our business. You ensure that every guest feels welcome and enjoys 
smooth, friendly service.
 

 
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Welcoming guests and guiding them to their table 

• Presenting the menu and providing additional explanations where necessary 

• Advising customers on their choice of food and drinks 

• Serving drinks and food 

• Clearing tables and ensuring a tidy environment 

• Helping to maintain general hygiene 

• Working in both the bar and the restaurant (no worries we’ll be happy to train you) 

We are looking for candidates who are 
willing to work hard, don’t like standing still, and are 
eager to work. 
 

 
 

-> 
Don't have that much 
experience in the hospitality industry yet? That's no problem—we'd be happy to teach you the ropes. As long as you're in 
good physical shape, there are plenty of opportunities.
 

 
 

Since we’re located in the heart of the capital, knowing a few 
languages is definitely helpful. The languages most commonly spoken here are 
Dutch, English, and French. It’s therefore no small advantage to be fluent in at least two of these languages.
 

 
 

Since closing time is around 11 p.m. to midnight, it’s convenient if you 
live nearby (i.e., within walking or biking distance, but not too dependent on public transportation—and definitely not on a car; parking in Brussels won’t make you any richer).

• As a Client Advisor in our NATO office, you will act as the first point of contact for clients within your assigned client segment (expats). 

• You will be responsible for the end-to-end management and accurate follow-up of your non-life insurance portfolio. 

• You will advise clients, prepare quotations, contact clients, discuss the proposed insurance solutions, and issue new insurance policies. 

• You will process all relevant data and contracts in our BRIO management system. 

• You will communicate with both insurers and clients on a daily basis via email and telephone. 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in insurance or an equivalent qualification. 

• You have several years of experience in the insurance sector. 

• You have a solid understanding of non-life insurance products and enjoy advising clients within your assigned client segment (expats). 

• You are sociable and communicate confidently with clients in person, by phone and via email. 

• You are customer-focused and combine this with a commercial mindset. You recognize opportunities and proactively pursue them. 

• You have professional communication skills in English and/or French and/or Dutch. 

• You are accurate, organized, and meticulous in your administrative work, ensuring all information is correctly recorded in our BRIO management system. 

• You are proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook) and are comfortable working with BRIO. 

• You are willing to work from our NATO office and understand that access to the premises is subject to NATO’s strict security and registration procedures. You are comfortable complying with these requirements. 

• You are willing to work from the NATO office every weekday.

As a Team Leader – Production, you play a key role in our manufacturing operations. You are responsible for coordinating the daily production activities while leading and supporting your team. By combining a people-oriented leadership style with a focus on quality, safety, and continuous improvement, you help achieve production targets and maintain the highest quality standards.

Your Responsibilities:

• Lead, coach, and motivate operators on the production line.
• Foster a positive, respectful, and collaborative team environment.
• Monitor and continuously improve quality, safety, and workplace organisation.
• Oversee the daily production schedule and ensure the production line operates efficiently.
• Manage stock levels and ensure the correct use of materials.
• Work with production software and ERP systems, including Iris and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
• Perform basic administrative tasks and prepare production reports.
• Communicate effectively in either Dutch or English with colleagues and stakeholders.

Are You the Team Leader We're Looking For?

• You have strong leadership and coaching skills and know how to inspire a team.
• You communicate confidently, clearly, and with a positive attitude.
• You are comfortable working with computer systems and quickly adapt to new software.
• You work accurately and have a strong focus on quality, safety, and efficiency.
• You are fluent in Dutch and/or English.
• Experience in a manufacturing or production environment is an advantage.

ViaMotive is not a traditional company. As a multi-brand dealer for brands such as Higer, Temsa and EVM, we provide smart solutions for professional passenger transport.
 

With the growing number of electric buses, our workshop is changing too. That's why we're looking for a skilled 
Diagnostic Bus Technician to join our team.
 

At ViaMotive, you will diagnose technical problems on modern buses and work together with your colleagues to get our vehicles safely back on the road. Every day is different and offers new technical challenges.
 

Your job
 

As a Diagnostic Technician, you will find, analyse and solve technical problems on buses.
 

Your tasks include:
 
 

• Diagnosing technical faults using diagnostic equipment. 

• Reading fault codes and electrical diagrams. 

• Solving mechanical, electrical and electronic problems. 

• Carrying out maintenance and repairs. 

• Testing vehicles after repairs. 

• Helping colleagues with more complex technical issues. 

• Learning about new technologies, including electric buses. 

Who are you?
 
 

• You have a degree in Automotive Technology, Electromechanics, or similar experience. 

• You have experience as a diagnostic technician, bus technician or truck technician. 

• You have a good knowledge of mechanics, electricity and electronics. 

• You have experience using diagnostic tools. 

• You have a category B driving licence (category D is a plus). 

• You can communicate in English or Dutch. 

• You work accurately, care about quality and enjoy working in a team.  

Experience with electric vehicles or an HEV2 certificate is an advantage, but not required. A strong technical mindset and willingness to learn are just as important.
 

Practical
 
 

• Day shift from Monday to Friday. 

• Roadside assistance is mainly during working hours. If you are willing to help outside working hours when needed, this is a plus.

Job description 

Are you an experienced truck driver with a passion for the open road? We're looking for a professional and motivated CE driver to join our team for international and national transport routes.

As a driver, you will be responsible for the safe and timely delivery of palletized goods to our clients, including well-known companies like Hubo and Gamma. Your duties include loading and unloading the truck independently and ensuring deliveries to around five customers per day.

You’ll spend +/- 3 nights per week in your truck, giving you the freedom and independence that come with this role. Your routes will mainly take you through the Benelux, Northern France, and the Ruhr region. You are also responsible for maintaining the black box records and accurately completing CMR documents.

You will work closely with the planning department and always adhere to traffic rules and safety regulations. With your professional and safety-first mindset, you help ensure satisfied customers and a smooth operation.

What We Offer

    
• 
        
International routes with +/- 3 overnight stays per week

    
    
• 
        
Additional 2 days of national transport

    
    
• 
        
A dynamic and independent role within a stable and growing company

    
    
• 
        
Positive work environment with short communication lines

    
    
• 
        
Competitive employment conditions

    

Requirements

    
• 
        
Minimum of 3 years of experience in transport

    
    
• 
        
Able to load/unload independently and open/close the curtain (baché)

    
    
• 
        
Flexible, motivated, and open-minded attitude

    
    
• 
        
EU drivers welcome – must speak good English or German

    
    
• 
        
Strong sense of responsibility regarding safety and compliance

    

Types of Goods Transported

    
• 
        
Aluminum profiles

    
    
• 
        
Automotive parts (e.g. for Honda)

    
    
• 
        
Construction materials

    
    
• 
        
Various general goods

    

Application Process
 Requirements 

    
• You have a CE driving license and code 95.
    
• At least 3 years of experience with a tractor-trailer.
    
• You are customer-friendly and speak good English.
    
• Basic knowledge of French, German, or Dutch is a plus!
